name: Bhapa Doi
subtitle: sweetened yogurt steamed until it sets like a baked custard

ingredients.note: hung, or it will not set

prepNotes: Three ingredients and one variable: how thick your yogurt is. Watery yogurt will not set no matter how long you steam it.
It should still wobble when you take it out. It firms in the fridge.

steps.text: Hang the yogurt in muslin for 2 hours to drain off the whey.
Whisk it smooth with the condensed milk, milk and cardamom. Do not aerate it.
steps.tip: Whisk to combine, not to fluff. Air bubbles give a pitted surface.

steps.text: Pour into ramekins or a single dish and cover tightly with foil.
Steam over simmering water 25 minutes, or bake in a water bath at 160C for 30 minutes.
Test with a skewer: it should come out clean but the centre should still wobble.
Cool, then refrigerate at least 4 hours. Top with pistachio and saffron before serving.

storage: Keeps 3 days refrigerated. It is a set dairy custard, so keep it cold and do not leave it out.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
nutrition.caveat: Whey poured away when the milk is curdled means much of the weighed input is never eaten, so the real figures are likely lower.
